text:
maya: FYI: target cut for v1.12.0 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need docs + Console UI + SDK docs all in sync. Who's on docs/SDK cutover?
anita: I'll own docs deploy. Planning to regen the static site and push to staging by 06:00 PT. Will need changelog entries merged.
jeff: I'll regen SDK docs and bump the npm/pypi versions. Will open PRs for changelog + version bump shortly. @sam can you confirm branch cutoff?
sam: Branch freeze at 04:00 PT tomorrow. No new features after that — only critical bugfixes + changelog tweaks. Tag the release branch: release/v1.12.0
jeff: PRs: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1012 (docs), https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/790 (sdk docs). Bumping package.json:
```
"version": "1.11.2" -> "1.12.0"
```
anita: Docs steps I'm doing:
- regen site: `make docs-build`
- preview: `./scripts/serve-docs.sh --staging`
- deploy: `./deploy/docs-deploy --target staging`
I'll post preview link when up.
ci-bot: Build started for PR #790 — SDK docs regen. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/790 (running)
anita: Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v1.12.0 :eyes: Check console screenshots under /guides/console for updated UI copy.
maya: Also need Console release notes updated in Console release tab. @jeff can you paste markdown for notes?
jeff: Adding changelog section:
- Added per-route latency breakdown in Console
- SDK: regen docs with new retry options
- Fix: KV cache cold-start perf improvements
I'll paste the markdown into the Console notes UI.
sam: Reminder: If any migrations required, put warnings in staging docs and set rollback playbook. No migrations here.
anita: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1012 — includes screenshots + updated Console guide. Ready for review.
jeff: SDK PR merged -> tagged v1.12.0. Commands run:
```
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "v1.12.0"
git push origin v1.12.0
./scripts/publish-sdk.sh --version 1.12.0
```
ci-bot: Release pipeline: all checks passed. Staging deploy succeeded. https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/12345 :white_check_mark:
maya: Awesome. Final cutoff reminder: 04:00 PT freeze, 06:00 PT docs staging up, 09:00 PT prod release. If anything blocks, ping here or page on-call.
anita: I'll watch deploy at 05:30 PT and confirm prod docs deploy post-release. :rocket: 
jeff: If prod SDK publishes fail, fallback: rollback tag and republish from release branch. Noted.
maya: Thanks everyone :tada:
